explanation: The value is 0 at every GO and D2 step and at every D1 that follows an unrewarded trial; it rises only at a D1 showing a reward, mostly in the second half of the episode (trial 45 and later; before that it stays near 0). It is highest (about 10, sometimes 6) for the first reward after one or more unrewarded trials or right after a switch of choice, then drops with each further reward in a row (about 10 or 8, then 5, 3, 1) and is 0 during long stable streaks of rewards.
